summary: Comprehensive implementation plan to elevate DeepTutor into an institutional academic learning management and curriculum engineering platform. Covers curriculum ingestion and automated decomposition, reference material analysis, contact-hour structured lecture notes in PPT/PDF/Word formats, 3-tier standard assessment generation with marking schemes and question banks, multi-year student biodata and marks ledger, multimodal deep solve with voice/image/document analysis, offline-first local storage, and responsive optimization for Windows PC and Android.
